invariants.rationale: Method creates and returns a new HoodieWriteMetadata object; this should not be null under correct execution.
The HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>> instance's write status list is expected to be non-null after execution.
getWriteStatuses() should return a List as per the declared type.
The records parameter is always passed to the commit action executor and should not be null for normal execution.
The instantTime parameter is expected to be non-null as it is used for commit identification.
